CHECK BURST K3p-xv-idle-matte-01 — TRIM THE HALO on the video idle that Matt passed by eye (R-48: 'perfect except for the white glow around the character'): re-matte the 16 registered frames with a tighter edge, measure the halo before and after, re-encode the loop. task_id "K3p-xv-idle-matte-01".

Inputs (read-only): the registered frames /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K3p-xv-idle-cut-01/frames/idle/S/idle_S_00.png … idle_S_15.png (512×512 RGBA, matted with alpha_floor=40 from the Grok clip); the native split is NOT available here — work on these RGBA frames. Frozen tools (read-only; run, never modify): gates/matte_quality.py (spill, edge_halo, particle_loss — read the docstring for its inputs), gates/matte.py, gates/common.py. ffmpeg at /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg. PIL + numpy + scipy glue only; no new tool files.

Do: (1) measure the halo on the input frames with gates/matte_quality (edge_halo + spill per frame) and ALSO a direct number: the mean luminance of the 2-px alpha band (0 < alpha < 255) minus the mean luminance of the 2-px opaque interior band beside it — a bright fringe is a positive value; report per frame. (2) Produce TWO trimmed variants, each written as a full 16-frame set: A = 'erode 1': alpha := alpha with a 1-px binary erosion of the alpha ≥ 128 mask applied (pixels outside the eroded mask → alpha 0), plus a green DESPILL on the remaining edge band (for pixels with 0 < alpha < 255: if G > max(R,B) reduce G to max(R,B)); B = 'erode 2 + floor 96': the same with a 2-px erosion and any alpha < 96 → 0. Write out/A/idle_S_00..15.png and out/B/idle_S_00..15.png. (3) Re-measure (1) on A and B; report the three sets side by side, and the alpha area lost per frame in %. (4) Encode three Chrome-playable MP4s (H.264, yuv420p, 8 fps, the 16 frames looped 4 times, each 512 frame centred on a 1024 canvas at 2× NEAREST on #3a3f4a, display only): out/idle_S_video_input_8fps.mp4, out/idle_S_video_A_erode1_8fps.mp4, out/idle_S_video_B_erode2_floor96_8fps.mp4; and out/edge_crops.png — the same 96×96 crop around the near shoulder edge from frame 4, input | A | B, ×4 nearest, on #3a3f4a. (5) out/checks.json = SPEC § 1 result envelopes for the halo numbers (passed null — Matt's eye rules), out/checks_readme.txt with the exact commands.
No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used must be 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K3p-xv-idle-matte-01"; images []; calls_used 0; files: every out/ file with sha256; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns must name anything you could not compute. Never PASS/FAIL.
